name: riverbend
setting: a river valley at the edge of an old forest, where a cart road crosses the river on a wooden bridge and a farm track fords it downstream; a woodcutter's cottage stands by the road

zones.desc: open forest floor under old oaks and beeches: moss, leaf litter, ferns, roots
open forest floor under alders and beeches: moss, leaf litter, ferns, roots, a fallen log
sunny summer meadow, tall grass with poppies, cornflowers and daisies

river.desc: a clear river flowing west to east: calm and deep in the west, squeezed between boulders into rapids in the middle, then spreading wide and shallow over a pebble ford in the east

paths.desc: packed dirt cart road with two wheel ruts and grass on the crown
farm track of trodden earth leading down to the ford
farm track of trodden earth coming up out of the ford
a few flat stepping stones to the cottage door

bridges.desc: wooden plank bridge seen from above: weathered planks laid across, a log railing along both long sides, resting on the banks

buildings.desc: a woodcutter's one-room cottage shown with its roof removed: thick stone and timber walls, a hearth on the west wall, a bed in the north-west corner, a table with two stools, shelves and a woodpile inside by the door

props.desc: a chopping block with an axe and a stack of split firewood
a small vegetable garden: three rows of cabbages and beans behind a low wattle fence
